title: pleopeltis elliptica
intro: Pleopeltis elliptica, commonly known as the elliptical polypody, is a type of epiphytic fern native to Central and South America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to reduce inflammation, protect against cell damage, and combat infections. The therapeutic actions of Pleopeltis elliptica include its ability to lower blood pressure, improve wound healing, and exhibit potential antidiabetic effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
